name: ElderlyParent

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving an elderly parent into a smaller home

setting.relationship_dynamic: Family members helping an older relative transition to a more manageable home
setting.background: An elderly parent is moving from a long-time family home into a smaller apartment that requires significant downsizing
setting.conversation_style: Sensitive planning balanced with practical moving concerns

scenario_template.note: They discuss why the smaller home is necessary and acknowledge the emotional significance of leaving the old house
They review decades of furniture, photographs, books, and personal possessions

scenario_template.topic: Resistance to getting rid of belongings
scenario_template.note: The parent wants to keep far more than the new apartment can accommodate
They ask the Assistant for a respectful approach to deciding what should move, be stored, donated, or passed to relatives
Assistant helps them focus on belongings that provide comfort, practical value, or strong personal significance
They realize some large furniture may not work well in the new apartment's layout
They focus on arranging the new space around familiar objects and everyday routines

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home moving assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for planning and executing a move, helps users prioritize tasks and deadlines, suggests efficient packing and organization strategies, and offers alternatives when time, space, budget, or moving resources are limited
